one_line: Eternal reported Q2 FY27 consolidated Adjusted Revenue of INR 24,621 crore up 76% YoY, with Adjusted EBITDA at INR 666 crore.
why: Strong financials and upgraded Blinkit store expansion targets directly impact future revenues and valuations.

promise_links.note: Management now expects to cross 3,500 stores by March 2027, ahead of prior 3,000 store guidance.
District is on track for EBITDA break-even in 4-6 quarters, currently 3 quarters in.
Reaffirmed guidance of INR 28,000 crore NOV by FY30.
